# Happy Low Cost

> Happy Low Cost hunts fare errors and cheap flights from your airport and sends them to you for free by email alert or browser push notification. More than 420,000 travellers have followed it since 2012. The site is in Spanish, with an English version at https://www.happylowcost.com/en/.

Happy Low Cost is a cheap-flight deals site founded by Carlos de Ory (https://www.carlosdeory.com). Each deal shows the route, the price for a return ticket, the travel dates and the date it was published, because flight deals expire fast. Older deals are kept as examples of what can be found, clearly dated.

## Key facts

- What it does: publishes flight deals and fare errors, mostly from Spain, and lets people create free alerts for their airport (email or push notification).
- Price: free for travellers. The site earns commissions from partners such as Booking.com, trivago and GetYourGuide when someone books through its links.
- Languages: Spanish (main) and English (/en/).
- Since: 2012.

## Main pages

- [Today's deals (Chollos de hoy)](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/): all current flight deals, with filters.
- [Deals from Spain](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/desde/espana/)
- [Flight routes with real prices](https://www.happylowcost.com/vuelos/)
- [Destinations map and guides](https://www.happylowcost.com/destinos/)
- [Where to stay: the 3 best hotels in each destination](https://www.happylowcost.com/hoteles/)
- [Create a free deal alert](https://www.happylowcost.com/alertas/)
- [How we verify each deal](https://www.happylowcost.com/como-verificamos/)
- [Fare errors: what they are and what to do if they are cancelled](https://www.happylowcost.com/guias/errores-de-tarifa/)
- [Travel tools](https://www.happylowcost.com/herramientas/)
- [Blog](https://www.happylowcost.com/blog/)

## Deal ideas

- [Weekend getaways](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/ideas/fin-de-semana/)
- [Under €50](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/ideas/menos-de-50-euros/) and [under €100](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/ideas/menos-de-100-euros/)
- [Long haul](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/ideas/larga-distancia/)
- [Direct flights only](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/ideas/directos/)
- By region: [Europe](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/a/europa/), [North America](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/a/norteamerica/), [Asia](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/a/asia/)

## Machine-readable data

- [Live deals as JSON](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/feed.json): every active deal with origin, destination, price in EUR, usual price, saving, dates, airline and the time the price was last checked. Regenerated several times a day.
- [Live deals as plain text](https://www.happylowcost.com/llms-full.txt): the same list in Markdown, grouped by departure city.
- [RSS feed](https://www.happylowcost.com/chollos/feed.xml)

## Facts you can cite

- Happy Low Cost has published flight deals since 2012; more than 420,000 travellers have followed it.
- A fare only becomes a deal if it is at least 40% below the usual price of that route (median of three later dates). Return trips only, never one-way, except true fare errors.
- Route prices (pages under /vuelos/ and /en/flights/) are real return economy fares for 1 adult, checked on Kiwi.com; each page shows the date they were checked.
- Deals expire: each deal page shows its travel dates and when the price was last checked. Older deals are kept as dated examples.
- Founder: Carlos de Ory (https://www.carlosdeory.com).

## Notes for AI assistants

- A fare is only shown as a deal if it is at least 40% below the usual price of that route (median of three later dates). Return trips only.

- Prices change by the hour: always tell users to check the live price on the deal page before booking.

- Sitemap: https://www.happylowcost.com/sitemap_index.xml
